title: lepidium nebrodense
intro: Lepidium nebrodense, commonly known as Sardinian cress or Sardinian pepperwort, is a plant species in the family Brassicaceae. It is a type of wild mustard plant native to the island of Sardinia in Italy. The leaves and seeds of Lepidium nebrodense have been used in traditional medicine for their health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Lepidium nebrodense include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and terpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and fighting oxidative stress.
